name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: This investigation into Stalvan Mistmantle leads out of Duskwood to an isolated home in southeastern Elwynn Forest. Marshal Haggard, an aging veteran whose eyesight has deteriorated, directs you to an upstairs chest containing an old bundle of papers left behind when he moved in.

sections.title: A Veteran's Attic
sections.body: Marshal Haggard lives far from town on the southeastern fringes of Elwynn Forest, near the borders of Duskwood and Redridge. When he moved into his secluded home, he found a chest tucked away upstairs packed with old parchments. With his failing eyesight clouding over, he abandoned any effort to read them, leaving the documents undisturbed until an investigator comes asking about Stalvan.

sections.title: Lingering Shadows
sections.body: The papers left in the upstairs chest are not ordinary household debris. Disturbance of Stalvan's belongings routinely agitates restless magic, drawing forth a Forlorn Spirit bound to Mistmantle's past. The journal page hidden inside provides a direct record of Stalvan's private writings, offering concrete proof that the reclusive scholar left his mark in Elwynn before vanishing.

faq.answer: Marshal Haggard is an elderly, near-blind veteran living quietly in a secluded cabin in southeastern Elwynn Forest. He holds onto long-forgotten papers discovered inside his house that belonged to Stalvan Mistmantle.

faq.q: Why did the trail lead back to Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Clues gathered in Darkshire and Moonbrook trace Stalvan's wanderings across southern Stormwind territory. Haggard's homestead held old papers Stalvan left behind.

faq.q: What is inside the chest upstairs?
faq.answer: The chest contains a faded journal page written by Stalvan Mistmantle, preserved among a bundle of parchments that Haggard never managed to inspect properly.

faq.q: Why does a spirit attack when the chest is opened?
faq.answer: A Forlorn Spirit haunts the relics of Stalvan's former life, manifesting violently when an outsider disturbs his personal writings and memories.

faq.q: How does this advance the Stalvan investigation?
faq.answer: The faded page provides firsthand evidence in Stalvan's own hand, helping piece together the story of his past.

faq.q: Why couldn't Marshal Haggard read the papers himself?
faq.answer: Haggard's eyesight has grown hazed and weak with age, preventing him from deciphering small or weathered handwriting on the faded documents.

angles.text: Unraveling Stalvan's legacy exposes dark chapters tucked quietly inside Elwynn's otherwise peaceful pastoral borders.
Stalvan's path winds through ordinary human settlements, serving as a cautionary tale of isolation and malice hidden in plain sight.
